scope: independent read-only source/workflow review with isolated disposable Git fixtures; no real BSP mutation/build/device execution

findings.detail: Original profile/template scans ignored special children and accepted a nondirectory destination; existing output regular-file path also passed until late mutation. Driver author has applied early kind checks and five negative cases; final recheck pending.
Original log guard omitted materialized device destination, permitting extra logfiles followed by failure after source patches. Author has added guard/test; final recheck pending.
Default check mode executed a repository-configured core.fsmonitor helper; disposable fixture returned0 while marker was written. Reproducer fsmonitor-reproducer.json. Fix pending.

Default check mode executed a configured cleanfilter selected by tracked.gitattributes when Git compared same-byte touchedworktreefile. --no-ext-diff/--no-textconv alone do not disable cleanfilters. Reproducer cleanfilter-reproducer.json. Fix pending.

confirmed_initially: No explicit download, host package installation, physical device/mount/flash command or GitHub Actions path in driver.
Only --run enters source mutation then envsetup/lunch/make droid; host Git and explicit JDK/Python version commands execute during default checks.
SourceHEAD/staged/assumeunchanged/skipworktree/untracked definitions checks and byte-verified patch-prefix replay are present.
Existing output marker includes source pins/patches/product plus JDK/Python/kernel selectors; it is not a resolved full-AOSP lock.
limits: Local host executables themselves are assumed trusted.
The review does not establish complete module closure, boot, physical hardware or correctness of third-party BSPscripts executed by explicit --run.
